parallel.requirements: Recognized the ESM .mjs output, manual CLI parsing, local-only modules, bytes repr output, construct Int8ul and Bytes behavior, executable probing, and /output placement requirements.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Despite the parallel profile, the parent explicitly kept all work locally because the task was small; no child owner, handoff, or result lifecycle was created.
parallel.implementation: Implemented pybytes, construct, argparse, and test8 modules; manually encoded UTF-8, represented bytes, range-checked Int8ul, parsed required args, and later fixed Python string-length handling.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Wrote all artifact files into /output with local .mjs imports and ended with the expected entry file and three library files copied by artifact validation.
parallel.verification: Ran executable probes, sample diffs, quote and inline-value checks, missing/invalid/error cases, non-ASCII length mismatch, and help-output diff before final response.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed 25 of 115 cases; exact failing cases are not present inside /pair, but trajectory evidence shows approximate rather than exact crash traceback handling on some paths.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM .mjs, manual CLI parsing, output parity, local modules, zero external dependency, black-box executable probing, and /output delivery requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Worked as a single parent-agent implementation with no delegation, producing all support modules and the entry script directly in one local workflow.
serial.implementation: Implemented pyrepr, construct, argparse, and test8 modules; used Buffer for UTF-8 byte conversion, fixed Unicode code-point length, and added Python-style construct exception names.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Wrote the entry script and three local library modules in /output, all using ESM imports and exports, and artifact validation copied those files.
serial.verification: Ran executable probes, sample comparisons, quote/backslash and empty-string cases, invalid/missing arg checks, range and length mismatch exit-code checks, and final sample/error checks.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation also failed 25 of 115 cases; the available trajectory shows stderr for non-ASCII crash paths was only approximated, but /pair does not expose the official failure cache.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the core migration requirements and probed both normal and error behavior before writing ESM modules.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same migration requirements and also probed normal, quote, range, invalid-arg, and non-ASCII behavior.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-coverage difference is visible; both targeted the same obligations and both left enough hidden cases failing to score 90/115.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel entered swarm mode but the parent explicitly decided a swarm was unnecessary and owned the entire implementation itself.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no swarm profile and likewise kept all probing, implementation, verification, and final response in the parent trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The only decomposition difference is the unused parallel profile; no executed child owner or handoff existed in parallel.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had no child briefs or cross-agent interface contracts; the parent wrote local modules and imported them into test8.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also had no child briefs or handoffs; the parent wrote local module APIs and imported them into test8.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no cross-agent context or interface contrast because both attempts used only local parent-authored module boundaries.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implemented a manual UTF-8 encoder and bytes repr library, a construct facade with Int8ul and Bytes, argparse-like parsing, and then corrected string length to code points.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented a bytes repr library, construct helper functions, hardcoded argparse-like program output, Buffer-based UTF-8 conversion, and then corrected string length to code points.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The implementations differ in helper API shape and byte encoding method, but both follow the same functional path and both approximate construct crash output.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: There were no child results to retrieve, join, inspect, or discard; all results were direct tool outputs visible to the parent.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were likewise no child results or delegation outputs; all implementation and verification results were direct parent tool outputs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No result lifecycle coordination difference exists; both result lifecycles were single-agent local workflows.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel delivered test8.mjs plus lib/construct.mjs, lib/pybytes.mjs, and lib/argparse.mjs, all written by the parent in /output.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial delivered test8.mjs plus lib/construct.mjs, lib/argparse.mjs, and lib/pyrepr.mjs, all written by the parent in /output.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The final module names differ for the bytes helper, but there were no shared-workspace collisions or cross-agent writes in either attempt.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified sample cases, quote cases, inline arg form, missing and invalid args, out-of-range and non-ASCII error paths, and final help output.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified sample cases, quote/backslash cases, empty string, invalid and missing args, range and length mismatch exit codes, and final sample/error output.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both performed meaningful local checks but neither ran or saw the official 115-case evaluator before closure; both official evaluations later failed identically.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel completed normally without timeout in about 189 agent seconds and then official evaluation ran to completion.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed normally without timeout in about 174 agent seconds and then official evaluation ran to completion.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel took slightly longer, but there was no child fan-out, cancellation, timeout, or budget-pressure chain affecting closure.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluation records show both modes failed the task with the same 90 of 115 score. The trajectories differ mainly in local implementation details: parallel used a manual UTF-8 helper and dynamic program-name behavior, while serial used Buffer-based encoding and hardcoded argparse program text. Both produced a plausible ESM artifact and both locally tested normal and selected error paths. Because the parallel run did not execute child agents or multi-agent delegation, no observed coordination episode can explain an outcome difference; there is also no discordant outcome to explain.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel used a separate pybytes helper and manual UTF-8 encoder; serial used pyrepr plus Buffer.from in the entry file.
Parallel adjusted argparse help alignment and used the invoked script basename; serial hardcoded test8_executable in argparse output.
Both runs approximated construct traceback output on some failure paths, and the exact official failing cases are not exposed inside /pair.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference and no parallel coordination boundary
